summary: Second-round audit of axel 2.17.14 Conan recipe. All 7 previously identified issues have been verified as correctly fixed: (P0) fake status published→built in manifest.yaml/README.md/notes.md — all now correctly show 'built'; (P2) manual mirror URLs removed from conandata.yml — only official GitHub release URL remains; (P2) patch_description now has 4-digit number prefixes (0001-0004) with space separation; (P2) test.sh has set -euo pipefail; (P2) test.sh uses [step]/[ok]/[fail] format with 8-space indentation; (P3) url field in conanfile.py is filled with recipe repo URL; (P3) deactivate_conanrunenv script removed. Full re-audit across all 14 changed files found no new P0/P1/P2/P3 issues. conanfile.py uses Conan 2.x API correctly, method order is standard (export_sources→requirements→layout→source→generate→build→package→package_info), package_info sets bindirs for CLI tool, SSL flags sourced from Conan dependency (not bare env vars). conandata.yml has official HTTPS GitHub release URL with valid 64-char sha256. All 4 patches have substantive platform adaptation logic (OHOS triplet detection, pthread_cancel compat, HMDFS umask fix) — no empty stubs. test_package runs actual axel binary via test.sh (not a fake test). commands.json correctly declares type='tool' at software level. manifest.yaml/notes.md/README.md all consistent and honest. No deception, no fake artifacts, no forbidden files, no CI gate bypass.
